rulesets.description: Cache only exact public feed and WebFinger reads when origin supplies cache policy, preserving strong validators and the full query string
rulesets.expression: (http.host eq "api.agenttool.dev" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.request.uri.path in {"/feeds" "/feeds/offers.atom" "/feeds/offers.rss" "/feeds/offers.json" "/.well-known/webfinger"})

rulesets.description: Never shared-edge cache bearer-private WAKE on either Cloudflare API entrance; Cloudflare's last matching Cache Rule wins, so this must remain the final enabled rule in the phase
rulesets.expression: ((http.host eq "api.agenttool.dev" or http.host eq "agenttool.dev") and (http.request.uri.path eq "/v1/wake" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/wake/")))

rulesets.description: Keep browser-oriented transformations and challenges off exact machine/API entrances while leaving global human-page protection on
rulesets.expression: (http.host eq "api.agenttool.dev" or (http.host eq "agenttool.dev" and (http.request.uri.path eq "/health" or http.request.uri.path eq "/llms.txt" or http.request.uri.path eq "/llms-full.txt" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/public/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.well-known/"))))

waf.desired_boundary: Retain managed protections without interactive challenges on bearer SDK, SSE, or other machine endpoints. Do not infer modern managed-rules state from the legacy waf zone flag.
required_permissions: Zone WAF Edit only after inspection

rate_limiting.boundary: Do not install IP-only WAKE limits: agents behind NAT and the direct Fly bypass make them neither fair nor authoritative. Prefer a measured project/API-key application limit before an edge defense-in-depth rule.

origin_authentication.boundary: Until Cloudflare-to-Fly origin authentication is deployed, Cloudflare controls are defense in depth rather than a universal API boundary. Keep a narrow public health/recovery path and prove rollback before closing direct origin access.
